Use case: illustration-story. Asset: landscape editorial illustration for an article about software factories. Show a conveyor belt carrying feature cards through a small automated workshop staffed by three friendly industrial robot arms: one builds a software window, another examines it through a magnifier, a third packages a completed application. An input backlog of feature cards enters at one end; finished application windows leave the other. Minimal clean flat illustration, white background, muted amber, lavender and slate accents, precise simple shapes, plenty of breathing room. Visual metaphor for agents working through a software backlog. No people, no lettering, no text, no logos, no watermark. This is an illustration, not a flowchart.
